title: A better first hand
question: Which home screen should I build? You can also describe a change below.

options.label: The opening hand
options.thesis: Choose how to play from a hand of oversized interactive cards.
options.viewport: A compact UNO title above three fanned card controls; Play sits forward.
options.risk: Expressive card controls need excellent labels on small screens.

options.label: The club lobby
options.thesis: A clear play menu beside the full comic cast.
options.viewport: Large title and Play on the left; friends and the cast own the right.
options.risk: More familiar composition, with less of a signature gesture.

options.label: The comic triptych
options.thesis: Three equal comic panels make every way to play obvious.
options.viewport: Play, Create and Join become bold illustrated columns below UNO.
options.risk: Equal panels can weaken the priority of instant play.
